summary.background: The objective of this paper was to quantitatively analyze the effect of concentrated animal feeding operations (CAFO) NPS pollution on a small watershed water quality.
summary.method: Modeling was conducted to evaluate the effect of CAFO NPS pollution on the water quality at the watershed outlet.
